errors.evidence: The description only details the data for the outer ring (2021) and completely omits all data points for the inner ring (2014). The primary purpose of the chart is to compare the two years, making this a major omission.
The color for the 'Verkehr' segment is described as brown ('braun'), but it is gray in the chart.

The description is truncated and does not list all categories for the year 2021. It stops after mentioning 'Sport/Erholung' and omits its value (3.6%) as well as the following categories: 'Abfallwirtschaft' (3.4%), 'Kliniken' (3.2%), 'Kultur' (2.4%), 'Gasversorgung' (1.5%), and 'Übrige Versorgung' (1.3%).
